title: Conway Cubes
description: Simulate a 3D and 4D cellular automaton using sparse coordinate sets.
writeup:
## Approach

A Conway's Game of Life variant in higher dimensions. Using sparse sets of active cube coordinates avoids allocating enormous arrays.

## Part 1

Start with the 2D input at z=0. Each cycle, count neighbors for every cell adjacent to an active cube using a `Counter`. Active cubes with 2 or 3 neighbors survive; inactive cubes with exactly 3 neighbors activate. After 6 cycles, count active cubes. Each cell has 26 neighbors in 3D.

## Part 2

Same logic but in 4D (add a w-coordinate initialized to 0). Each cell now has 80 neighbors. The sparse set approach scales well — only cells near the active frontier are examined, not the entire 4D volume.
